name: Hotel booking attributes
description: Every value a guest or the platform supplies along the search-to-confirmation journey. Types, limits and allowed values follow the service configuration and validators; examples form a valid standard booking.
generationMethod: Booking drivers come from the test case; every other attribute takes the example value the hotel data dictionary specifies, so each data set is a complete, valid booking unless the case deliberately breaks one value.

attributes.name: search.destination
attributes.description: Destination code the guest searches (demo catalogue: New York, London, Paris)

attributes.name: stay.checkInOffsetDays
attributes.description: Check-in date as days from today (0 = today)

attributes.name: stay.nights
attributes.description: Nights between check-in and check-out (PAR allows at most 21)

attributes.name: occupancy.rooms
attributes.description: Rooms requested

attributes.name: occupancy.adults
attributes.description: Adults in the party (at least one per room, at most 4 per room)

attributes.name: occupancy.children
attributes.description: Children in the party (at most 3 per room)

attributes.name: selection.hotelId
attributes.description: Hotel chosen from the results

attributes.name: selection.roomCode
attributes.description: Room type chosen on the hotel details page

attributes.name: selection.ratePlanCode
attributes.description: FLEX = pay at hotel with a card guarantee; SAVER = prepaid, non-refundable

attributes.name: extras.code
attributes.description: Optional ancillary added to the cart (empty = none)

attributes.name: extras.quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the ancillary

attributes.name: guest.firstName
attributes.description: Guest first name

attributes.name: guest.lastName
attributes.description: Guest last name (also verifies a confirmation resend)

attributes.name: guest.email
attributes.description: Where the confirmation e-mail goes

attributes.name: guest.phone
attributes.description: Optional contact phone

attributes.name: guest.arrivalTime
attributes.description: Optional expected arrival time (HH:mm)

attributes.name: payment.token
attributes.description: Token from the secure payment component; raw card numbers are never accepted

attributes.name: consent.privacyNoticeAccepted
attributes.description: Guest confirmed the privacy notice

attributes.name: consent.marketingOptIn
attributes.description: Optional marketing consent

attributes.name: notification.locale
attributes.description: Language of the confirmation e-mail

attributes.name: request.idempotencyKeyPrefix
attributes.description: Prefix of the Idempotency-Key sent with a reservation (the full key is 8 to 64 characters)
